diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.karpenter declares depends_on = [module.eks], but its values string already references module.eks.cluster_name and module.eks.cluster_endpoint, so Terraform already infers the dependency on module.eks. The explicit depends_on is redundant and can be removed.

The Karpenter controller authenticates through EKS Pod Identity (module.karpenter sets create_pod_identity_association = true and the chart only configures a service account name, no IRSA annotation), so it requires the eks-pod-identity-agent add-on to be running to obtain credentials. helm_release.karpenter currently has no ordering relative to aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent — they sit on parallel branches (helm_release.karpenter waits on module.eks/module.karpenter, while the add-on waits on module.self_managed_node_group) — so the controller can be deployed before the Pod Identity agent is available. Add depends_on = [aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent] (or otherwise wire the ordering).
